contract.location: implementation-plan.json -> adoption_contract; keeps the existing layer plan

relationship.evidence_ids: Nonempty IDs from the actual reading
relationship.adopted_value: Explicit relationship to retain/change; user data need not resemble reference values

open_item.evidence_id: Every inferred/unknown reading item appears exactly once
open_item.question: Specific information missing, rather than a vague request for more context
open_item.affected_layer_ids: Exact reading layer IDs affected by this uncertainty

resolution.description: Supported definition, explicit adopted preference, or reason this feature is not required

checks: reading provenance and exact layer coverage
adopted physical layout and implementation route
contract.limits: Record completeness only. Source semantics, experimental independence, statistical validity, actual artist values, export fidelity and visual quality remain separate checks. No renderer or Agent turn is started.

scope: Actual final extracted checkpoint CLI and sibling reference_packet fallback closure; record contract discovery only.
